text: XXXX years ago in XX/XX/2021, my son had an XXXX visit with 5 days without insurance. The hospital, XXXX 's XXXX of Colorado neglected to work with me despite numerous contact attempts, and ignored me for over a year. XXXX 's then sent me to collections with BC Services who again, did not respond appropriately to attempts to correct the balance owed. BC Services after 1 year of ignoring every request along with XXXX XXXX XXXX XXXX Colorado tried to sue me, and sent a police officer to my door. Under the immense pressure of having police at my door for my son 's emergency medical debt, they made me set up and sign an agreement for payment. This was only after I was being sued and sent to court. There are phone recordings of me crying hysterically and BC Services not paying attention or following appropriate protocol. I since, have again reached out to XXXX XXXX XXXX XXXX Colorado and sent notice to BC Services that payment would be on hold until any discrepancy was rectified. I have put in 2 complaints with BC Services now, and they have simply been closed with no additional explanation. This collection company is not honest, and they are not following protocol. I find this to be a violation of rights set forth by Colorado laws regarding medical debt and I am astonished that this can keep happening.
